_comment: The bosses' definitions (Nat, 25 Oct: "other than the dragon priest we should develop other bosses people could grind for special drops/schematics"; design _work/boss-roster-design-1025.md on the PC). Read by tools/bosses/bosses_build.py, which resolves every editor id and desc against the load order, picks each spot's anchor and writes bosses.json for bosses.js. spots: candidates, the first is used; a boss with enabled false waits on Nat (his eye on the spot, or an item still being built). bossEdid / addEdids: NPC_ or LVLN editor ids. drops: always [[desc, count]] or alwaysEdid [[editor id, count]] (looked up and checked), shards { desc, count, top } (an item made for this boss, filled in once it exists), schematic { family, chance } (smithing.json family; a smith who knows it gets knownBonus of the shards instead), extra [[desc, chance, count]]. waves: at a share of the boss's health, n adds of addEdids. night: true writes its zones only at night (worldclock.js), a fight in progress running on; event { minutes, waveEverySeconds, waveSize } writes them only while a staff-started event lasts (/bossevent <id>), with a wave every waveEverySeconds. Seconds throughout.

bosses._note: Proposed 25 Oct (the Leader for Nat): vanilla's top werewolf boss (EncWerewolf06Boss, Dawnguard's ladder) named and rim-lit; the server's SetScale is a stub, so the boss is its own NPC_ on the Behemoth race (DLE 1D2207, Nat 25 Oct: 1.3x the pack: race 1.30 x NAM6 1.13 = 1.47 against the adds' 1.13). Pack: a werewolf and two wolves at the start, then 3 and 4 more (werewolf, wolf, wolf in turn). Drops: a Werewolf Pelt (Hothtrooper's werewolf fur and leather recipes take it) and three wolf pelts, gold, Silver 5% (the hunter's metal, Hircine's joke), Glass 1%. Every zone is hostile, player werewolves included. fullMoon true (here or in its config block) keeps it to full-moon nights
